title: Snake in a Box (Spiral)
hints: Keep four boundaries: top, bottom, left, right. Walk the top row, then the right column, then the bottom row backwards, then the left column upwards, shrinking a boundary after each.
After the first two walks, check top <= bottom before the bottom row and left <= right before the left column, or a single row/column is visited twice.
Use int (not size_t) for the boundaries so that bottom = rows - 1 and decrementing cannot wrap around.
